Jan. 4 Wm. Chrysler - 96 - never baptized was recommended to our prayers last Friday, when things looked threatening. He asked to be taken to a sisters hospital - Chatham - Now things going more promisingly
Peter Neil J. McLean - 11 - hurt Nov. 17th blood poiaon and bone infect.
7
Mrs. Martin - of Utica - wants elderly lady to take care of baby - Mrs. Frances Poulos - 51 - diabetic complication - great pain - En- rolled To-night at 9 P.M.
E'd McNamara - 40 - threatening to marry a divorced person before a minister.
Gerald Baumgartner - 16 - brain fever when a year old, never really well since; Four years ago had arm broken - seems to infect. of bone
Page 255
Mrs. Mary Sikie - 57 - nerves - all-most palsey .....
Jan. 11 13 Thanks: - Robert Thorn - 63 - came totally blind and in terribe pain from ulcerated eyes. Enrolled(perpetually) in Ser. Masses .... comes To-day seeing - pains were gone next day.
Mary Howe - 15 - home from Adrian for vacation - vanished Jan. 4th & no trace of her since.
14 Blandine Lipke - 33 - colitis fears serious operation
14 Mercdythe Ann Webster
Mrs. Mary Olsheski - 75 - intestinal trouble. Left Detroit last Feb. - for Grand Rapids .. Saturday bad turn ....
Mrs. A. C. Miller - 96 - lost husband yr. ago. - operation expected next Friday a.m. Expected .... breast cancer?
